title: Travel Hours Drawn for an Onsite Date on a TimeBank Block
content:
**Trip hours.** A travel entry on a TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours block draws the onsite trip hours of the block's size for the date's trip, with no ratio applied, rounded half up to the hundredth of an hour. A block whose size carries onsite trip hours of zero draws no travel, and a travel figure of zero means no travel entry is drawn for the date. The travel hours are rounded once, on the final figure.

**Date figured.** Trips are figured one date at a time: the date figured is the date of the block's most recently dated onsite-support draw, a date's trip being posted at the close of that date and before any later date's visit is drawn, so no earlier date is left waiting for its trip. When the block's ledger carries no onsite-support draw, or it already carries a travel entry dated that date, no travel entry is figured.

**Ticket booked.** The trip is dated that date and booked to the ticket of that date's onsite-support draw recording the most worked minutes, the higher ticket number ending a tie. Each onsite date's trip is priced from that date's onsite-support draws, the ticket the trip is booked to and the client's own records alone.

## Worked cases (hypothetical ledgers)

| Block size | Onsite trip hours | That date's onsite-support draws | Travel entry |
|---|---|---|---|
| TimeBank 10-Hour Block | 1.0 | ticket ending 101 at 90 minutes, ticket ending 102 at 120 minutes | 1.00 hour, booked to the ticket ending 102 |
| TimeBank 40-Hour Block | 0.5 | ticket ending 201 at 60 minutes, ticket ending 205 at 60 minutes | 0.50 hour, booked to the ticket ending 205 (tie, higher number) |
| TimeBank 160-Hour Block | 0.0 | any | none |
| TimeBank 40-Hour Block | 0.5 | a travel entry already dated that date | none |
